programs.title: How I Got Here
programs.desc: Twenty years ago, Philippe left his homeland in the South of France; he and his daughter, Valentine, travel back to uncover the truth about their family and reconnect with the vibrant French culture.

programs.title: Quest for the Lost Vikings
programs.desc: As planning for a northern expedition continues, the Farm Heim team starts testing the gear they will use in their bigger quest. Meanwhile, Jo, Johann, and David set out for Berens River, a place with potential clues of Lost Vikings.

programs.title: To Kill a Dictator
programs.desc: Although Stalin was paranoid, there's little doubt that many wanted him dead; analyzing if the last plot against Stalin's life was successful; discussing if succumbing to illness at 74 means that his death is less than natural.

programs.title: I Died... And Came Back
programs.desc: An attempt at taking her own life leads to one woman's encounter with an afterlife she never expected; a regular visit to the DMV leads to an out-of-body experience that transports a woman into another dimension.

programs.title: Secrets in the Ice
programs.desc: Human remains high in the Ecuadorian Andes; in Norway, an archaeology student unearths metal artifacts; a strange, earthquake-like event in Canada; a Viking longhouse with a unique history in Greenland.

programs.title: Into the Universe: Mysteries of the Cosmos
programs.desc: From Galileo to Einstein to Hubble, scientists have long grappled with the shape and scale of the universe; as technology expands our view, missing space curvatures and inconsistent data related to Hubble's constant keeps us mystified.
